verdict: Adaptive (2.88 NLL, 17.9 PPL) is worse than uncompressed (12.2 PPL). Fixed-rank baseline (2.65 NLL, 14.0 PPL) performs better than adaptive at same budget. Adaptive NLL is not > baseline NLL + 0.5 (2.88 < 3.15), so hypothesis not falsified by this threshold, but adaptive significantly underperforms uncompressed.
